content.title: 'Summer House' Cast 'Betrayed' by Amanda Batula and West Wilson's Romance Reveal After They 'Openly' Lied (Exclusive Source)
content.text: Amanda Batula (left), West Wilson (right). Credit : Charles Sykes/Bravo via Getty; Jocelyn Prescod/Bravo via Getty NEED TO KNOW Summer House costars Amanda Batula and West Wilson confirmed they are dating in a statement on March 31The news comes after weeks of speculation and two months after Batula split from her husband of four years, Kyle CookeA source tells PEOPLE there's "a lot of hurt, a lot of confusion and a feeling of betrayal" among the cast, particularly given Wilson's previous relationship with Ciara Miller The Summer House cast is reeling after Amanda Batula and West Wilson confirmed their relationship. On Tuesday, March 31, Batula, 34, and Wilson, 28, shared identical statements on their Instagram Stories, calling their relationship "very new" as they said, "It was never our intention to purposely hide anything. Given the complicated relationship dynamics involved and the scrutiny that comes with being on a reality show, we need a little space to process things privately before speaking on it." A source tells PEOPLE that "most people on the cast did not see this coming, and many are still in the dark about what has actually occurred." Batula and Wilson "kept this very secretive and were openly lying about it," says the source, "which forced everyone else to put it together over the past few days as the rest of the world did the same." "There's a lot of hurt, a lot of confusion and a feeling of betrayal among the friend group," the source says. The cast — which includes Carl Radke, Lindsay Hubbard and Jesse Solomon — are "rallying around Ciara [Miller] and Kyle [Cooke]," the source says. Wilson dated Miller during his first season on the show in 2023, but the pair broke up that December. Batula, meanwhile, split from Cooke, her husband of four years, in January. The source says the cast is "hoping to have a clearer set of answers when the reunion films in a few weeks." Kyle Cooke and Amanda Batula (left); Ciara Miller and West Wilson (right). Bryan Bedder/Bravo via Getty; Griffin Nagel/Bravo via Getty In their statement, Batula and Wilson said a romantic relationship was "the last thing either of us expected" and "grew out of a genuine, long-standing friendship, which made it especially important for us to approach this with care." "As our feelings evolved, we wanted to take time to understand exactly what we were feeling," the statement continued. "We also recognize that this has had an impact beyond just us and never wanted our actions to cause any hurt or be perceived as careless." The confirmation came after weeks of speculation among fans that was heightened when Southern Charm star Austen Kroll posted a photo on March 29 with the caption: "Pasta and f* your friends exes are apparently so back." After Kroll posted the veiled message on his Instagram Stories, several Summer House stars shared their own posts, seemingly reacting, including Radke and Hubbard. Related Stories Wilson had previously denied the romance speculation on Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen. "We were just hanging out in New York. She's single, I gotta show her the streets a little bit," he said on March 24. "But if it's not clear, that's a very important person to me, and I care about her a lot." Wilson further added that Batula is just his "homegirl" and not a romantic interest. "That's a friend. I hope it's clear," he said at the time. West Wilson, Amanda Batula, Carl Radke, Lindsay Hubbard and Kyle Cooke attend Bravo's "Summer House" Season 10 at 92NY on January 28, 2026 in New York City. Dimitrios Kambouris/Getty Batula has also weighed in more broadly on the idea of getting involved with one of her costars. On the March 9 episode of Jason Tartick's Trading Secrets podcast, she said, "I'm not touching any of my castmembers. Love them dearly, but I'm good." Batula's ex-husband was asked about the rumors on Watch What Happens Live earlier this month, and called them "kinda shocking" and "outrageous." While he said he didn't "think there's any merit to" the speculation about his ex-wife and his costar, if it were to be true, Cooke, 43, said, "It would certainly catch me by surprise and feel a little reckless, and I think I'd probably be the last person people would be worried about. I think Ciara would probably have something to say." "But if it made Amanda happy, I think I just would have to vote yay," he said.
